QUOTE: The client's default retry policy is exponential with `retryLimit: 3` (`app/managers/network_manager.ts:68-73`). But `createPost` in `app/client/rest/posts.ts:43-47` passes `noRetry: true`, which `app/client/rest/tracking.ts:383-385` turns into `retryPolicyConfiguration: {retryLimit: 0}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default exponential retry with limit 3 in the network manager and that createPost opts out via noRetry.
